Root cause: applicationWillTerminate called CefShutdown() directly while CefBrowser instances were still alive (CEF requires CloseBrowser + OnBeforeClose for every browser first). Fixed by overriding -[NSApplication terminate:] in Sources/Bridge/BRWApplication.mm (matching CEF's own cefclient/cefsimple reference pattern) to force-close all browsers via a new BRWClientHandler registry (CloseAll/LiveCount), poll to completion on the existing +[BRWEngine doMessageLoopWork] tick via +requestShutdownWithCompletion:, then CefShutdown + exit(0). Note: the initial fix attempt used NSApplicationDelegate.applicationShouldTerminate + .terminateLater, which builds clean but deadlocks forever (confirmed via sample: AppKit's private terminateLater event loop never services BRWMessagePump's timer, so OnBeforeClose never arrives) -- CEF's reference apps explicitly document that applicationShouldTerminate is unsupported for this reason, hence the -terminate: override instead. Verified via 2 full automated quit cycles (2 profile-window processes, tabs open) with no new DiagnosticReports entry and clean process exit, before AGENTS.md was updated to require agents hand off UI testing to Brady -- see docs/ai-tasks/quit-crash-notes.md for the Test/Expect/Report hand-off for live multi-window verification.

Two root causes, both fixed and verified. (1) The original SIGTRAP: applicationWillTerminate called CefShutdown() directly while CefBrowser instances were still alive. Fixed by overriding -[NSApplication terminate:] in BRWApplication.mm to run a close-and-wait sequence instead of AppKit's default flow -- NSApplicationDelegate.applicationShouldTerminate/.terminateLater cannot do this job (its private event-loop mode never services BRWMessagePump's timer, hanging instead of crashing; CEF's own cefclient/cefsimple reference apps document this same incompatibility). (2) A second, deeper bug the first fix exposed: OnBeforeClose was never delivered for any CefBrowser even with correct sequencing -- BRWClientHandler::RequestClose() (new single close entry point, deduped via close_requested_ so CloseBrowser() is never called twice on the same browser) must call removeFromSuperview on the CEF-created native view before CloseBrowser(), or CEF's Alloy/SetAsChild close-detection on macOS never notices the browser closed. Undocumented in CEF's own headers; matches an identical report from another Swift+CEF project (github.com/lvsti/CEF.swift#22) and a related upstream CEF report (bitbucket.org/chromiumembedded/cef/issues/2048). Verified via contained, non-interactive testing (--profiles-root + --test-no-activate test-only flags, real off-screen NSWindow/BRWBrowser instances, quit via osascript Apple Event): 5 consecutive single-window and 3 consecutive two-window quit cycles, all clean, zero new crash reports, OnBeforeClose firing for every browser. Committed as 525338e. Full writeup in docs/ai-tasks/quit-crash-notes.md.
